title: Panoptes Calibration-Transfer Card
description: Signed calibration-transfer matrix. One scorer is frozen after training on the global train partition; for each source cohort an isotonic calibrator is fit on that cohort's calibration partition only, then applied to every target cohort's untouched test partition. The diagonal is in-cohort calibration; off-diagonal cells isolate calibration portability from representation learning.

matrix.description: source cohort -> target cohort -> cell. Each cell carries source_cohort, target_cohort, on_diagonal, counts, prevalence, discrimination/calibration metrics, calibration-fixed operating points, conformal coverage, selective risk, and a group-bootstrap interval.

delta_from_target_diagonal.description: source cohort -> target cohort -> metric deltas relative to the target's own diagonal (in-cohort) cell.

summary.description: On- vs off-diagonal means and the calibration-transport AUROC gap.
